title_en: Hadith al-Thaqalayn: Its Chain of Transmission and Significance (Episode 74)
description_en: Hadith al-Thaqalayn: Its Chain of Transmission and Significance (Episode 74), an episode of the program Al-Utruha al-Mahdiyya by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: A continuation of the detailed study analyzing the chains of narration and implications of Hadith al-Thaqalayn.
